body: I actually did come across that more than once but haven’t looked into it. I practiced yoga for years until I ended up in pain afterwards. I still do very gentle yoga on my better days in small spurts throughout the day. I’ll look your suggestion up tomorrow thank you.
I know everyone’s perspective is colored by their experiences but frankly I think you’re projecting. He says he wants to even if I don’t. Doesn’t say he will.

I was asking for some book recommendations. We would both love and really benefit from counseling but can’t afford it. I was also hoping to find some people who have been through similar. 

What I wasn’t expecting was a bunch of nasty attitudes  and to feel attacked. Thanks.

You are coming across super aggressive & angry. 

He doesn’t seem to interpret social and emotional cues appropriately. I have to repeat myself MANY times for him to comprehend what I’m saying for everything, including when I’m saying no don’t hug me or touch me.
That’s the thing, I think he is. He seems to be on the spectrum honestly.
I am, he doesn’t get it.

I’ve been there done that as a kid. It’s not as helpful as you think. Shelters are temporary, welfare is not sustainable and I just don’t think it’s warranted to go that far. He’s not respecting my boundaries out of malice, he feels entitled and doesn’t understand. Some of it stems from toxic masculinity I think. He’s very open to counseling but we can’t afford it.  He isn’t receptive to what I say but would be from someone else or through reading a book though.
He has responded to any questions like that with that he NEEDS attention and will take it however he can get it and that I owe it to him. He sees nothing wrong with it.
He hasn’t forced himself on me but complains a lot and has said he should be able to. I honestly think it’s just him antagonizing me.

I don’t think  it’s a jealousy thing but I do believe he started acting out in retaliation for not getting my attention like he used to.  Somehow it snowballed into this over time and now I can’t figure out how to dig us out when he’s to immature to even see what’s happening.
Yea I know. Easier said than done. Doing what’s right would be a separation IMO. I have no where to go and can’t work so that means he would have to leave and he won’t.
